requiredFix: Multi-parent target selection must be regulated only by receipts that are at least target-eligible for GUT contamination triage; non-qualifying receipts must remain auditable but must not manufacture target multiplicity. Preserve HOLD for two genuinely qualifying receipts targeting two distinct parents.
promotionGate: Add adversarial tests for non-GUT, incomplete, missing-provenance, and unauthorized-classification receipts targeting a second parent; retain genuine multi-target HOLD and single-parent scope rejection; pass focused VAJRA and cross-organ/integration CI before closing this evidence or changing displayed state.
